title: The Gough Map: Britain's oldest road map, measured
excerpt: I found 157 towns by eye on a map of Britain drawn about 1360. Its shape puts a typical town 18 km out of place and blows Wales up, yet 72% of the miles written along its red roads are within 25% of the real road.
seo_description: The Gough Map of about 1360 measured: 157 towns located, a shape 18 km out, and written miles right to 25% on 72% of roads.
header_alt: Title card reading 'The Gough Map' in black and red on pale paper, beside a crop of the medieval map of England and Wales with small black rings on the towns, and the lines '157 towns found by eye' and '72% of written miles right to 25%'.
